summary.text: Danny Hamrick is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 69, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former delegate who represented District 48 from December 2012 to December 2022.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a small business owner and automotive locksmith.

paragraphs.text: Hamrick graduated from Liberty High School and is self-employed.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance history lists him as losing House races in District 41 in 2006, 2008 and 2010, and winning District 48 in 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018 and 2020.

In the 2021-2022 session he was vice chair of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and also served on the Education, Government Organization, Political Subdivisions, and Technology and Infrastructure committees.
Hamrick lost the Republican primary for District 69 to Keith Marple in 2022 and again in 2024.
On May 12, 2026, he won the Republican primary for the seat with 43.8% of the vote, ahead of incumbent Keith Marple and Andrew Yost.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hamrick said he is focused on growing the economy, cutting unnecessary regulations, and supporting small businesses.
He said he is also passionate about education reform, tax relief, public safety, and constitutional freedoms.
